parts.text: ABCD is a rectangle. The equation of the line AB is x y 4 3 24 + = .

content.tex: The equation of the line \(AB\) is \(4x+3y = 24\) .
Rearrange the equation \(4x+3y = 24\) to make \(y\) the subject.
